sloka: दिव्य आभरण चित्रांगम् दिव्य रूपम् यशस्विनम् ।दिव्य माल्यांबर धरम् महेन्द्रम् इव दुर्जयम् ॥४-३३-६४॥
transliteration: divya ābharaṇa citrāṁgam divya rūpam yaśasvinam ।divya mālyāṁbara dharam mahendram iva durjayam ॥4-33-64॥

translations.english: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.
translations.hindi: A चारित्रं रक्षितं त्वय भ्रन्त;पु स्त्रयवलो स्नेनमनुचितमिति बहिरेव . त्रर्याख्चशः सरा: ३४ उस समय यशस्वी सुग्रीव दिव्य गहने दिव्य वख और दिव्य पुष्प मालाग्रों के पहनने से बड़े सुन्दर ओर इन्द्र की तरह दुर्जय देख पड़ते थे
